recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future clarification of Resource $validate semantics should proceed through later unresolved work such as FHIR-37998, not by reopening FHIR-7001, whose specific missing-label request is already satisfied.
issue_request: FHIR-7001 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request against BaseResource/resource operations. The DSTU1 ballot comment said the Resource $validate operation description used "[missing]" for the case where no mode parameter is supplied, which made the specification look incomplete, and asked for that label to be corrected to "Mode Not Provided".
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 6418, imported as git commit 270c3c07be0eb9ca74f2e225891344f959f71885. That commit changed the Resource spreadsheet operation description from "[missing]" to "[mode not provided]". The 2021 source refactor in commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 moved the operation definition into source/resource/operationdefinition-Resource-validate.xml and preserved the corrected label.
additional_context: Resource is active in source/fhir.ini and source/resource/list-Resource-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/Resource-validate, so the checked OperationDefinition is in current build scope. Current source has no remaining "[missing]" label under source/. FHIR-37998 raises broader unresolved $validate-mode questions, and FHIR-8446 separately corrected an adjacent typo, but neither changes the FHIR-7001 correction.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/resource/operationdefinition-Resource-validate.xml already says "[mode not provided]: The server checks the content of the resource against any schema, constraint rules, and other general terminology rules".
